fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Edinburgh teaches its one-year master's courses on campus in Edinburgh. MSc Computer Science is taught at the School of Informatics, at Central Campus, 11 Crichton Street. Indian students may qualify for the **£5,000 India Merit Scholarship**, covered below.

The most important thing to know is the cost. International tuition is **£47,680 a year** for the courses on this page. Plan for the full first-year total in the next section, not only the tuition figure.

| | MSc Computer Science | MSc Data Science | MBA |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tuition for international students (2027/28) | **£47,680** a year | **£47,680** a year | **£47,680** a year |
| Length | 1 year, full-time | 1 year, full-time | 12 months, full-time |
| Start | September 2027 | September 2027 | Multiple start dates |
| IELTS (overall) | **7.0**, with at least 6.5 in three parts and 6.0 in the remaining part | Same as Computer Science | **7.0**, with at least 6.0 in each part |
| Application fee | None | None | None |

## What it really costs

**Tuition.** For 2027/28 entry, the international fee is £47,680 a year for MSc Computer Science, MSc Data Science and the MBA. The MSc courses last one year. The MBA lasts 12 months.

**Tuition deposit.** A deposit is an advance payment that counts towards your tuition. It is £1,500 for MSc Computer Science and MSc Data Science. It is £2,500 for the MBA, and you pay it within 28 days of your offer.

**Application fee.** There is no fee to apply for any of the three courses.

**Living money for the visa.** The UK government wants proof that you can pay for your living costs. Outside London, the rule is £1,171 a month for up to 9 months. You must have had that money for 28 days in a row. The last day of those 28 days must fall within 31 days of the day you apply for your visa. For the full steps, read our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

**Visa and health fees.** The student visa fee is £558 when you apply from outside the UK. On top of that, you pay the Immigration Health Surcharge, which is £776 for each year of your visa.

### Worked first-year cost: MSc Computer Science

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition, 2027/28 | £47,680 |
| Living money: £1,171 a month x 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa fee (from outside the UK) | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 or more |
| **Total** | **at least £59,553** |

The arithmetic: £47,680 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 = £59,553.

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164.

The visa rules count up to 9 months of living money, so the example uses 9 months. Treat this as a planning example, not a budget. To compare costs across UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

### India Merit Scholarship

The India Merit Scholarship covers **£5,000** towards tuition fees for the 2027/28 academic year. It is for the first year of study only.

You may qualify if:

- you were domiciled in India when you applied,
- you pay international fees and are fully or partly self-funded,
- you have an undergraduate degree from India at or above the minimum grade in the university's grade tables,
- you join a full-time, on-campus taught master's course.

There is no separate application. The award goes to students who accept an unconditional offer. Read the [India Merit Scholarship page](https://registryservices.ed.ac.uk/student-funding/postgraduate/international/region/asia/india-merit-scholarship) for the grade tables and full terms.

## Getting in

MSc Computer Science asks for "a UK 2:1 honours degree, or its international equivalent." Check the course page and the India Merit Scholarship page to see how the university compares an Indian degree.

IELTS is an English test. For the two MSc courses, you need an overall score of **7.0**, with at least **6.5** in three parts and **6.0** in the remaining part. For the MBA, you need an overall score of **7.0**, with at least **6.0** in each part.

## Deadlines

### MSc Computer Science and MSc Data Science (September 2027 start)

| Round | Application deadline | Decision by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 31 March | 31 May |
| 2 | 31 May | 31 July |

### MBA (2027/28 entry)

| Round | Application deadline | Decision by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 14 Oct 2026 | 26 Nov 2026 |
| 2 | 25 Nov 2026 | 21 Jan 2027 |
| 3 | 27 Jan 2027 | 11 Mar 2027 |
| 4 | 3 Mar 2027 | 22 Apr 2027 |
| 5 | 21 Apr 2027 | 10 Jun 2027 |
| 6 | 9 Jun 2027 | 29 Jul 2027 |

Apply early. The visa timing matters as much as the university's deadline:

- You can apply for a student visa up to 6 months before your course starts.
- You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies), which your course provider gives you. A CAS is the university's official confirmation that it has accepted you.
- Some subjects need an ATAS certificate, which gov.uk says it takes at least 30 working days (6 weeks) to process. Ask the university whether your course needs one.

## Popular programs for Indian students

This page covers three courses: [MSc Computer Science](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught/110-computer-science), [MSc Data Science](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught/902-data-science) and the [MBA](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught/267-business-administration-master-of). Each one is a full-time course that starts in September 2027, except the MBA, which has several start dates.

## Where you'll live

The courses are taught on campus in Edinburgh. The study location is the Central Area, and the School of Informatics is at Central Campus, 11 Crichton Street.

The university guarantees an offer of university accommodation to new, single postgraduate taught students from outside the UK. To qualify, you must:

- apply for accommodation by 31 July 2027,
- accept an unconditional firm offer by 31 July,
- study the full academic year from September.

Check current room prices on the [university accommodation page](https://www.accom.ed.ac.uk/our-accommodation/?student=Postgraduate&catering=&room=) before you plan your budget.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- you want a one-year master's in Edinburgh and can show the first-year total of £59,553 (the example above),
- you can reach an IELTS overall score of 7.0,
- you can apply for accommodation by 31 July 2027 and want the housing guarantee,
- you may qualify for the India Merit Scholarship.

**Think carefully if:**

- you cannot show £1,171 a month for 9 months, plus the visa and health fees,
- you would miss the 31 July 2027 accommodation date, because the guarantee would then not apply,
- you choose the MBA and cannot pay the £2,500 deposit within 28 days of your offer.

To compare other options, start with the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Sources

Checked on 2026-11-03: [MSc Computer Science](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught/110-computer-science), [MSc Data Science](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught/902-data-science), [MBA](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught/267-business-administration-master-of), fee pages for [MSc Computer Science](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught-campus-fees?programme_code=PTMSCCMPSI1F&year=2027), [MSc Data Science](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught-campus-fees?programme_code=PTMSCDATSC1F&year=2027) and [MBA](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught-campus-fees?programme_code=PTMBABUSAD5F&year=2027), the [India Merit Scholarship page](https://registryservices.ed.ac.uk/student-funding/postgraduate/international/region/asia/india-merit-scholarship), and the [university accommodation page](https://www.accom.ed.ac.uk/our-accommodation/?student=Postgraduate&catering=&room=).

Checked on 2026-11-01: [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [Financial evidence for the student route](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/financial-evidence-for-student-and-child-student-route-applicants), [Healthcare surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay).

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much is tuition at the University of Edinburgh for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For 2027/28 entry, the international fee is £47,680 a year for MSc Computer Science, MSc Data Science and the MBA. The MSc courses last one year and the MBA lasts 12 months.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at the University of Edinburgh?
faq_json.a: Yes. The India Merit Scholarship covers £5,000 towards tuition for the 2027/28 academic year, for the first year of study only. There is no separate application.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for MSc Computer Science at Edinburgh?
faq_json.a: You need an overall IELTS score of 7.0, with at least 6.5 in three parts and 6.0 in the remaining part.

faq_json.q: When is the application deadline for MSc Computer Science at Edinburgh?
faq_json.a: Round 1 closes on 31 March, with decisions by 31 May. Round 2 closes on 31 May, with decisions by 31 July. These dates are for the September 2027 start.

faq_json.q: Is there an application fee for Edinburgh's master's courses?
faq_json.a: No. There is no fee to apply for MSc Computer Science, MSc Data Science or the MBA.

faq_json.q: How much money do I need to show for the UK student visa?
faq_json.a: Outside London, you must show £1,171 a month for up to 9 months, which is £10,539 for 9 months. You must have had that money for 28 days in a row.
